turns.title: Alert bot idea
turns.user: I want something that tells me when the dollar hits a rate I set. Where do I start?
turns.ai: Decide three things first: where to get the rate, how often to check it, and where to send the alert. Shall we go one at a time?
gist: Three things to decide: rate source · check timing · alert channel
Suggested deciding them one at a time

turns.title: Pick a rate API
turns.user: Where should I get the rate from? Something free.
turns.ai: For free, the public exchange-rate API is a safe choice. It only updates a few times a day, though, so it won't work for minute-by-minute alerts. First decide whether checking once a day is enough.
gist: Said the public exchange-rate API is a safe free choice
It updates only a few times a day, so not for minute-by-minute alerts
Asked to decide first whether once a day is enough

turns.title: What is the base rate?
turns.user: The response says 'base rate'. What is that?
turns.ai: It's the rate a bank uses as its reference for buying and selling dollars. When you actually buy, a fee is added so it costs a little more. For alerts, the base rate is fine.
gist: The base rate is the bank's reference rate for trading dollars
Said the base rate is fine for alerts

turns.title: How often
turns.user: Then let's check just once a day. What time is good?
turns.ai: 11 a.m. is good, after that day's rate is posted. Let's go with checking once a day at 11 a.m.
gist: Suggested 11 a.m., after the rate is posted
Decided to check once a day at 11 a.m.

turns.title: Alert channel
turns.user: Should alerts come by text message or a messenger?
turns.ai: For personal use, a Telegram bot is the easiest to build. Make one bot and with its token you can send messages.
gist: Said a Telegram bot is easiest for personal use
One bot and a token are all you need to send messages

turns.title: Several targets
turns.user: I want to set several target rates. Write up what we've decided so far in a document.
turns.ai: Keep the targets in a list and alert once each time one is crossed. I've written up what we've decided so far in plan.md.
gist: Targets go in a list, with one alert each time one is crossed
Wrote up the decisions so far in plan.md

turns.title: Skeleton

turns.ai: I made the two functions. fetch_rate() in rate.py returns today's base rate, and notify() in notify.py sends one line to Telegram. Please put the bot token in the .env file yourself.
gist: Made fetch_rate() in rate.py and notify() in notify.py

turns.title: What is a webhook?
turns.user: The docs mention a webhook. What is that? Do I need it?
turns.ai: It's when the other server tells your address first when something happens. This bot only sends, so you don't need one.
gist: A webhook is the other server telling you first when something happens
Said this bot only sends, so it isn't needed

turns.title: Versus polling
turns.user: Then how is that different from polling?
turns.ai: Polling is you asking at intervals; a webhook is them telling you. Checking the rate means asking once a day, so it's polling.
gist: Polling is you asking, a webhook is them telling you
